instructions.default:
Architecture documentation framework (sdd-monolito).

- Orchestrator: the `orchestrator` agent coordinates; it never writes specification content itself.
- Skills: resolve them through the `orchestrator-templates` skill registry and inject the matching compact rules into each subagent prompt as `## Project Standards (auto-resolved)`.
- Output: final specifications go to `docs/architecture/requirements/<change-name>/specification.md`.
- Runbooks: `docs/architecture/runbooks/`.

Subagents never read the registry themselves.
instructions.claude:
Architecture documentation framework (sdd-monolito).

- Orchestrator: `.claude/agents/orchestrator.md` coordinates; it never writes specification content itself.
- Subagents: `.claude/agents/subagents/`.
- Skills: `.claude/skills/`. Resolve them through `orchestrator-templates` and inject the matching compact rules into each subagent prompt as `## Project Standards (auto-resolved)`.
- Output: final specifications go to `docs/architecture/requirements/<change-name>/specification.md`.

Subagents never read the registry themselves.
instructions.codex:
Architecture documentation framework (sdd-monolito).

- Skills: `.codex/skills/`. Resolve them through `orchestrator-templates` and inject the matching compact rules into each subagent prompt as `## Project Standards (auto-resolved)`.
- The orchestrator agent lives in the `orchestrator` skill's sibling agents directory when one is installed; otherwise drive the flow from the registry directly.
- Output: final specifications go to `docs/architecture/requirements/<change-name>/specification.md`.
